source: human input through the AI input-output interface

requirement.statement: Everything crossing the input-output interface, regardless of modality, shall be suitably persisted in the repositories and, at suitable granularity and where scientifically or standards-relevant, processed as candidate new knowledge through machine-verifiable evidence toward Zenodo and, where appropriate, IETF, in a fully automated manner.
acceptance_criteria: Every observable I/O work unit has durable repository provenance or an explicit, machine-readable reason why persistence is impossible or prohibited.
Persistence is content-addressed or otherwise exactly bindable to the originating I/O artifact and model/tool identity.
Candidate knowledge is classified at suitable granularity rather than automatically promoted as a theorem or empirical fact.
Formalizable claims enter machine-verification gates; empirical claims retain independent-evidence boundaries.
Zenodo publication is attempted only after applicable exact-artifact, rights, provenance, scientific-status and external-effect gates pass.
IETF progression is attempted only for material that is technically appropriate for Internet standardization and after applicable draft, rights, provenance and external-effect gates pass.

Automation is fail-closed: a missing credential, authorization, exact-head binding, rights clearance, verification receipt or publication precondition yields HOLD/BLOCK rather than an invented success.
Every external effect produces a durable receipt that is reobserved and bound back into repository state.
A static read of /AI alone is not treated as proof that persistence or publication occurred.

implementation_directive.authorization: Product Owner explicitly grants implementation permission for this requirement.
implementation_directive.required_architecture: INPUT -> CAPTURE -> NORMALIZE -> HASH/BIND -> PROVENANCE -> REPOSITORY PERSISTENCE -> CLASSIFY -> VERIFY -> PUBLICATION DISPOSITION -> PRE-EFFECT GATES -> AUTHORIZED EXTERNAL EFFECT -> RECEIPT -> REOBSERVE -> REPOSITORY PERSISTENCE
implementation_directive.automation_target: repository-native, deterministic, restartable and auditable orchestration with no dependence on chat memory as authority
implementation_directive.external_effect_boundary: This implementation authorization does not itself assert that Zenodo/IETF credentials or every irreversible publication authorization are currently present. Existing exact-artifact and pre-effect controls remain binding.
